messages:
Jin (Support): Escalating FluxPath trial: onboarding pipeline is failing intermittently with '502 upstream' during conversation generation. Customer demo tomorrow and theyre paused on signing PO. Need CS to coordinate immediate enablement + looping Eng.
Priya (CSM): Thanks Jin. Can you paste the snippet and confirm org id? Also is this reproducible from their SDK or only via UI?
Jin (Support): Org: fluxpath-eval-42. Happens in both SDK and web UI when the session has ~3 long documents attached. Quick log: 
```
{"time":"2026-04-10T09:31:12Z","status":502,"detail":"upstream_service_error","req_id":"req_8b4"}
```
Jin (Support): Customer reports client retries and then sees rate-limited behavior.
Marco (CS Ops): I can open a temporary bypass route for trial org to a higher-capacity pool for 24h. Do we want to communicate proactively or wait until we know root cause?
Priya (CSM): Proactively. Message should say: were aware, temporary routing to a performance pool to keep the demo green, and a follow-up technical session with Eng to validate end-to-end. Marco, please add a note to timeline.
Devon (Eng Runtime): I'll join the technical session and pull service logs + tail the instance. Can you share approximate timestamps and sample conversation ids? If it's tied to long-document contexts we may need to throttle attachments per request.
Jin (Support): Sending convo ids in DM. Repro command we used: 
```bash
node reproduce.js --org fluxpath-eval-42 --file big_context.ndjson
```
Priya (CSM): Checklist: 1) Marco route bump for 24h 2) Draft comms (apology + temporary lift + invite to 45m technical call) 3) Schedule call today or morning demo prep 4) Tess/Renewals informed of elevated churn risk 5) Capture engineering remediation options (throttle, backoff guidance, SDK patch).
Tess (Renewals): Flagging renewal as at-risk. Please include a one-paragraph summary after call for the renewal playbook. I'll hold outreach until we confirm demo is stable.
escalation-bot: Incident INC-2026-4021 created: fluxpath trial routing bump. Assigned: eng-runtime.
Marco (CS Ops): Bumped routing to perf-pool-3 for 24h at 2026-04-10T10:05Z. Logged in account notes.
Jin (Support): Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick move. We'll try the demo again at 14:00 PT."
Devon (Eng Runtime): Quick findings: spike in backend queue around the request window, a few pods reported transient OOMs then crashloopbackoff. Suggest temporary concurrency limit + SDK guidance to chunk attachments. Will post fuller notes to the incident.
Priya (CSM): Great. I'll host the prep call at 13:00 PT with the customer + Eng + Support, and follow with the comms note. After call I'll update the renewal brief and playbook. :white_check_mark:
Jin (Support): Draft comm to customer: "Hi team — we're sorry for the interruption. We've routed your trial traffic to a higher-capacity pool for the next 24 hours and scheduled a short technical session to validate your demo flow. We'll follow up with recommended SDK changes and an ETA for a permanent fix." Feedback welcome before I send.
Priya (CSM): Minor tweak: add expected next steps and who to contact during the demo (my email). Otherwise send.
Tess (Renewals): Once you send the note, ping me the one-paragraph summary. I'll prepare an internal brief for AE.
Marco (CS Ops): Monitor active. I'll extend route if the demo shows instability.
Devon (Eng Runtime): Posted initial diag in INC thread: root cause likely memory pressure from large context batches; remediation plan includes SDK chunking example + runtime concurrency limit. ETA for a patch: 72 hrs.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll send the comms and run the enablement call. Follow-ups: add SDK chunking example to shared docs and record the remediation steps in the account timeline.
Jin (Support): Sent comms to customer at 11:20 PT. They acknowledged and will test at 14:00 PT.
Priya (CSM): Keep posting any logs or test results in the incident. Ill lock this thread after the demo if stable. :pray:
__notes: Synthetic Slack thread for a support->CS escalation around trial onboarding blockage and routing bump. Fields are strings or list of strings as required.
